race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 2yof Trotting Final (G1)
race.comment: Promising filly BUMPER CROP (2) stretched her unbeaten run to four when she drew on the back row and raced parked before scoring by 5m in last week's heat. That was her first outing for three months following on from her Nutrien Final win and she should only be better for it. Draws to enjoy the favours so can keep her perfect record intact. MAJARO GIRL (12) may need things to fall her way from the back row but she came from there when winning last week's heat. That made it two on the trot at this circuit and distance so she is in form at the right time. MISS MUSCLE (11) is a consistent filly who came from this row to place last week. Yet to miss the top-three and can play a role again. KYVALLEY DIXON (13) cops a tougher draw than when runner-up to BUMPER CROP last week but she has been progressing well having won three of her previous four starts. LOLLY (10) should be close to her peak now and is worth including after finishing runner-up in both starts off a spell.
